fullContentHtml:
MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) has recently published the official notification for the posts of Scientific Officer Biology on its official website. This recruitment has been issued for 25 posts. The online application process for MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 has started from 21 April 2026, and candidates can apply till 20 May 2026. Candidates must check the complete details of MPPSC Scientific Officer Biology Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 April 2026
  • Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 26 April 2026 to 22 May 2026
  • With Late Fee Phase I Last Date : 21 May 2026 to 27 May 2026
  • With Late Fee Phase II Last Date : 28 May 2026 to 28 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 22 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 12 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 540/-
  • MP Reserve Category : Rs. 290/-
  • PH (Divyang) : Rs. 290/-
  • Late Fess Phase I : Rs. 3000/- + Portal Fee
  • Late Fess Phase II : Rs. 25000/- + Portal Fee
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 40/- (Included)
  • Correction Charges : Rs. 50/- (Extra)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
